question_text: Outline how information hiding can control changes to a Product object’s price.
adaptation_rationale: Preserves private-access reasoning with a Python-appropriate controlled interface; naming conventions alone are not claimed to enforce security.
solution: Keep price behind a controlled class interface instead of allowing arbitrary external changes. A set_price method can reject negative values before updating state.

marking_points.criterion: Limits direct external access to price.
